title: CPU riders recover when stuck
summary: Authored port adaptation: CPU riders reset when stuck and recover using a validated point 80–500 ft along the route
details: From a CPU's 3rd reset at one place the leader speed limit lifts and it holds the racing line; from the 4th reset, or 15 s without 25 ft of progress, it resets to a validated point 80–500 ft further along the route, never crossing the finish gate or skipping an Enduro gate, never causing a DNF. Verification: headless sweep, 1 lap, 3 CPUs, idle player, seeds 7/11/23 on all 51 courses (32 National, 16 Enduro, 3 Short Track): every CPU finished in 153/153 runs (before: 147/153; stuck on sx15, sx03, sx05, env05endl). Runs without recovery are bit-identical to before. Browser race tests pass.
limitation: Thresholds tuned on idle-player sweeps only; underlying causes (sx15 jump leader limit, sx05 reset line, env05endl obstacle) unchanged; a skip moves a CPU up to 500 ft without riding it.
